svg.title: Bloodborne Legendary Run — Over a thousand goals, one sky to find your way.
svg.desc: Bloodborne Legendary Run: a web and Android app to follow a Bloodborne playthrough, where every goal becomes a star. 1,289 goals, 22 constellations, 864 guide entries in French (counted on 8 October 2026). Real screenshots of the app.
